question: Which of the following is a First Generation Computer?
solution:
The correct answer is __**SEAC**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **SEAC (Standards Eastern Automatic Computer)** is a **First Generation computer**.
 
• First-generation computers used vacuum tubes for circuitry and were operational in the 1940s and early 1950s.
 
• SEAC was designed for performing scientific calculations and was also used in various early applications, including weather forecasting and research.
 
• It was the first fully operational stored-program electronic computer in the United States, capable of executing instructions from a memory device.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ **

 
• **ATLAS**: This was a **second-generation computer**, built in the 1960s using transistors instead of vacuum tubes, making it much faster and more efficient than first-generation computers.
 
• **STAR 1000**: This was a **supercomputer**, considered part of the **third generation** or later, developed with integrated circuits.
 
• **ABACUS**: The abacus is not a computer but an ancient counting tool used for arithmetic calculations, predating modern computing by thousands of years.
